# post-postgres

## Type Aliases

### PostgresPost

```ts
type PostgresPost = SqlPostRuntime &
  Readonly<{
    send: (client, envelope) => Promise<void>;
  }>;
```

Post on PostgreSQL; the producer retains ownership of BEGIN and COMMIT.

### PostgresPostErasureStatement

```ts
type PostgresPostErasureStatement = Readonly<{
```

Parameterized native erasure; the producer controls BEGIN and COMMIT.

### purgePostgresPost()

```ts
function purgePostgresPost(source): readonly Readonly<{
  text: string;
  values: readonly (string | number | null)[];
```
